9.translation: What-is the purpose of the work? It is argued that therefore. It means that it is afterwards. Ansha-bhagena means that he worships and occupies all the powers of the parts, up to the pillars of Brahma and others, and that is the part-part, in that perfect form. That is, he divides it into parts, knowledge, wealth, strength, etc., and adds it to his own, as by that. That is, in part, in the form of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, part of the illusory energy is worship, which is the eye of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. or, by the part of the illusion, which is the part of the form of the incarnation of the modes of nature, etc., which is the difference of the parts. In other words, only the parts in the form of fish, tortoises, etc., are to be worshipped, not by the direct form of the One who has them. That is, it is defined as the worship of the Supreme Personality of Godhead in His completely perfect form, which is followed by His devotees in parts such as knowledge, strength and so on. Krishna, however, is the Lord Himself [Bh.P. 1.3.28]because it is said. He encourages her by saying, "You are in the womb of Yashoda" with three and a half syllables.

26.translation: Happy that the promise has been fulfilled, the saints first praise the truthfulness of the vow of truthfulness. That which is true to one’s vow and resolve. Truth is the ultimate and best means of attainment in which one is present. The threefold truth is the truth that exists without distinction in all three times, before creation, after creation and at the time of existence. That is what they call the womb of truth, the earthly and up-tejas by the word truth. By the word tych, the wind and the sky. Thus, truth and falsehood are the five elements. That is what they call truth, according to the Scriptures. The vagina is the reason for that. This has previously mentioned the present. Thus, in truth, it is inherent in the same, and it is situated in the innermost measure. This has shown that it is true even in the present tense. Similarly, the truth of truth is the truth of that very truth, the truth of the transcendental, and the form that will not disappear even after its destruction. This has shown the truth of the period in the catastrophes. Thus the threefold truth has been established. Similarly, the eye of truth, the voice of truthfulness, the voice of truthfulness, the vision of truthfulness, and the vision of equality are all explained by the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Truth is also an equal view. It is true that the poets have described the truth as a beautiful voice. Tyor’s eye is the means of sight, meaning the leader and the initiator. Thus, O Lord, in all respects we have taken refuge in You, who are truthful.

27.translation: Surely you, the Lords of the worlds, are equal to Me, why do you take refuge in Me? It is not to be said that You alone are the Lord of all, since You are the cause of all creation and other things, but we are Your one refuge, and to say that there is no duality in the form of the world and other things without You. That universe, the original tree, is cut down, and the tree is the form of the whole, the individual body. How-ever it happened? Ekayana is the one nature of the moon, which is the shelter of the moon. He who has two fruits, pleasure and pain. He who has the roots of the three modes of nature. The four tastes are the four tastes of religion, wealth, lust and liberation. He who has the five senses, the mode of knowledge, and the mode of knowledge. The six waves or cells are the nature of the self. whose skin is composed of seven metals. The five elements, the mind, intelligence and ego, are the eight branches of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The axle has nine doors and holes. He who has ten life-forces and leaves is called a dasa-chhadi. The bird in which the two Lords of the living beings are called Dvi-khaga.

35.translation: Tvayy ambujaksha [Bh.p. 10.2.30-32] It is said that only the devotees of the Lord attain salvation and no others. There, the fruit of action should not be without devotion, but since salvation is attainable only by knowledge, what about devotion? They reply to the doubters that if there is no Sattva. O Dhatar! If this Sattva were not Your own body, then knowledge would not be specific and indirect knowledge, which is the consequence. How-ever it happened? Wiping out the difference between ignorance and ignorance and the difference it creates, wiping out the difference between them is the deterrent. That is, it breaks ignorance, and the knowledge that breaks ignorance is wiped out, destroyed, and water is already attained. Surely there must be knowledge that the light from which the dull intellect and others are is Brahman? This is Chen, no. This means that You, the all-witness, are only inferred and imagined, not realized, by the lights of the modes, the lights separated from the modes. The type of inference is called the quality of whom and by whom it is revealed. This means that the relative to whom this inner quality of intelligence and others is illuminated, who is thus the witness of the modes, or by whom the intelligence-ascended quantity is inferred that the external quality is illuminated by the intellectual possessor. This means that when one worships You in the body of pure Sattva, by Your grace one attains direct realization in the inner action in that form.

39.translation: By saying that the burden has been removed by your birth, is it said that the world is like a living being for me? Well, O Lord, let us not argue about the cause of Your birth as non-worldly beings without play. And what, O refuge of fear, do not resort to fear, is that address. O eternally liberated, it means. What is to be said that there is no cause for Your birth, since even in the soul of the living entity, the ignorance caused by you and others about You is not the ultimate goal?
